datasets.description: Undirected, weighted, typed protein-protein association network with 132,534 nodes and 39,561,252 edges. Node features: 8-dim one-hot species indicator. Edge features: 8-dim. Task: multi-label node property prediction. Metric: ROC-AUC.

experiments_or_tasks: Ablation study on generalized message aggregators (SoftMax_Agg and PowerMean_Agg) with different hyperparameters.

methods.name: PlainGCN
methods.protocol_description: Baseline GCN stacking layers without skip connections. Each layer uses Sum, Mean, or Max aggregation. Layer normalization before ReLU. Depths: 3, 7, 14, 28, 56, 112.

methods.name: ResGCN
methods.protocol_description: PlainGCN with residual connections in order: GraphConv → Normalization → ReLU → Addition.

methods.name: ResGCN+
methods.protocol_description: Pre-activation residual connections: Normalization → ReLU → GraphConv → Addition.

methods.name: ResGEN
methods.protocol_description: ResGCN+ with generalized message aggregators (SoftMax_Agg_β or PowerMean_Agg_p) instead of Sum/Mean/Max. β and p are fixed hyperparameters.

methods.name: DyResGEN
methods.protocol_description: ResGEN with learnable parameters β, p, and optionally s (norm scaling factor in MsgNorm). Parameters initialized to 1 and learned dynamically per layer.

study_units.name: Ablation study on ogbn-proteins
